figures.finding: The USVI pays a 9% rebate on qualified production expenditure, plus a transferable tax credit of 10%, 15% or 17% of the first USD 500,000 paid to each resident when residents are 20-25%, 25.1-30% or over 30% of the workforce, and bonuses of 10% of spend for a USVI promotion and 10% for work on St. Croix; minimum spend USD 250,000, at least 20% of the workforce resident, a USD 500 application fee to the Economic Development Authority 120 days before to 30 days after principal photography; priority goes to resident companies.

value.base: qualified production expenditure in the USVI
value.administeredBy: USVI Economic Development Authority with the Department of Tourism (Film USVI)

figures.applies: US Virgin Islands; as Cast & Crew's incentive summary gives it (read 2026-11-01; filmusvi.com refuses this environment, 403).

sources.said: meet the minimum qualified spend of $250,000; see that a minimum of 20% of the workforce (including crew, extras, actors, and up to three paid interns) are USVI residents; … Earn 10%, 15%, or 17% of the first $500,000 paid to each USVI resident when the workforce is made up of 20% to 25%, 25.1% to 30%, or more than 30% of USVI residents, respectively. Additionally, a production company may earn a 9% rebate on QPE (which includes the first $500,000 of each resident’s wage). USVI offers a bonus equal to 10% of total QPE if an approved production includes a qualified USVI promotion PLUS another 10% of total QPE if the production activities take place in St. Croix. … along with a nonrefundable application fee of $500 … Priority for the rebate is given to resident production companies
